statement: An individual-patient-data meta-analysis of randomised trials of intracoronary adult cell therapy after acute myocardial infarction found no effect on left ventricular ejection fraction, ventricular volumes, or clinical events.

context.intervention: intracoronary bone-marrow or adult cell therapy

measurement.assay: imaging-derived LVEF and volumes; clinical events

replication.note: Individual patient data pooled across many independent trials.

drift: Individual positive trials from this era are still cited as evidence that cell therapy repairs the heart. Pooled at patient level, the effect is not there.
limitations: does not test pluripotent-derived cardiomyocytes, which are a different intervention

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
